chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Wisdom is the lost article of the believer, so take wisdom even from the people of hypocrisy.
ai.seo_question: What does the hadith 'Al-Hikmah dalalat al-mu'min' mean regarding the pursuit of knowledge?
ai.summary: This famous hadith, often cited in Shia jurisprudence to justify accepting knowledge from non-Shia sources, underscores the objective value of wisdom independent of the speaker's faith or piety. It reflects the Shia scholarly principle that truth is not confined to a single sect, encouraging believers to actively seek insight even from 'ahl al-nifaq' (those of hypocrisy) if it contains genuine benefit. This perspective highlights the pragmatic approach to knowledge acquisition in Islamic tradition, prioritizing the utility of the message over the moral status of the messenger.
